scenario_description: Preparation keeps network access, but the production workload runs without egress or host secrets.
expected: Repository preparation succeeds before isolation and the real workload still passes after isolation.
Direct IP and DNS egress both fail during the workload.
No sensitive host environment name is forwarded, the host stays unchanged, and the container is removed.
observed: The exact commit was fetched and installed during the SWE-ReX preparation phase while bridge networking was present.
Blackridge detached bridge, observed zero remaining container networks, and executed all four workload commands through shell-free docker exec.
The real unittest and add_one(41)=42 artifact passed after isolation; direct IP egress and DNS egress were false and sensitive environment names were empty.
The host snapshot was unchanged, exact docker rm --force cleanup exited zero, and no container remained.
notes: PASS is limited to the tested single-container production boundary; it is not a hardened multi-tenant claim.
